connection, signature $(-,+,+,+)$, two-form field, and SI conventions stated in

units C. In this adopted model, the word *barotropic* means that pressure is a
function of rest-energy density alone.

clauses:
Adopt the equation-based Einstein-Maxwell field postulate
[[post-emg-einstein-maxwell-equations]] and the smooth material closure of
[[post-emg-strict-charged-fluid-model]], with the SI, signature, and coordinate
conventions of [[def-emg-geometry-units]]. Thus the spacetime field equations
are $dF=0$, $\nabla_aF^{ab}=-\mu_0j^b$, and
$$G_{ab}+\Lambda g_{ab}=\kappa(T_{m,ab}+T_{\mathrm{EM},ab}),\qquad \kappa=8\pi G_N/c^4,$$
while the fluid contributes exactly its adopted $T_m,j$ and material balance
equations. No matter action is assumed.

**(a) Torus Sobolev branch.** If
$\Sigma=\mathbb T^3_{2\pi}=\mathbb R^3/(2\pi\mathbb Z)^3$ with the periodic
Sobolev spaces of [[def-gr-periodic-torus-and-sobolev-spaces]], assigning each
spatial period length $2\pi\,\mathrm m$ in the length-coordinate convention of
[F6]. Assume $s\ge5$ is an integer, $h\in H^{s+1}$ and
$K,e,b,\epsilon_0,u_0,Z_0\in H^s$, with the same strict compact
admissibility. Then there is $T>0$ and a solution on
$(-T,T)\times\mathbb T^3$ in the harmonic gauge of
[[def-gr-harmonic-gauge-and-reduced-equations]], relative to the fixed
background used by [[thm-emg-local-charged-barotropic-development]]. In
periodic charts,
$g\in L^\infty H^{s+1}\cap C^0H^s$,
$\partial_tg\in L^\infty H^s\cap C^0H^{s-1}$, and
$F,\epsilon,u,Z\in L^\infty H^s\cap C^0H^{s-1}$. The equations hold
classically, and the reduced solution is unique on common intervals with common
compact admissible bounds.

[F1] [[post-emg-einstein-maxwell-equations]]: For smooth $F,j,T_m$ on the
selected Lorentzian model, adopt $dF=0$,
$\nabla_aF^{ab}=-\mu_0j^b$, and
$G_{ab}+\Lambda g_{ab}=\kappa(T_{\mathrm{EM},ab}+T_{m,ab})$, with
$T_{\mathrm{EM},ab}=\mu_0^{-1}(F_{ac}F_b{}^c-\tfrac14g_{ab}F_{cd}F^{cd})$.

[F2] [[post-emg-strict-charged-fluid-model]]: Adopt smooth $\epsilon,u,Z$,
$p=p(\epsilon)$ with $\epsilon+p>0$ and $0<p'<1$,
$j=cN(\epsilon)Zu$,
$T_{m,ab}=(\epsilon+p)u_au_b+pg_{ab}$,
$\nabla^aT_{m,ab}=F_{bc}j^c$, and $u^a\nabla_aZ=0$; $N$ is the stated
positive EOS integral.

[F3] [[thm-emg-local-charged-barotropic-development]]: Its current Statement
has the same smooth constrained data, the same $(-,+,+,+)$ and Maxwell signs,
and the same torus Sobolev and smooth geometric local-development conclusions
restated here. Its current authored proof verifies the coupled reduction and uses the exact CP02 field-strength block [L1] and CP01 Maxwell-stress identity [L2]. These actual mathematical hypotheses are the premises used here; draft metadata records no independent proof approval.

[F4] [[thm-gr-constraint-equations-in-normal-frame]]: With
$K(X,Y)=g(\nabla_X\mathfrak n,Y)$,
$G(\mathfrak n,\mathfrak n)=\tfrac12(R(h)+\tau^2-|K|_h^2)$ and
$G(\mathfrak n,X)=(\operatorname{div}_hK)(X)-D_X\tau$; inserting
$G+\Lambda g=\kappa T$ gives exactly the displayed Einstein constraints.

[F5] [[lem-emg-observer-field-decomposition]]: In a positively oriented
future orthonormal tetrad, $F_{0i}=-e_i$ and
$F_{ij}=\varepsilon_{ijk}b_k$; these six components uniquely reconstruct a
two-form from the spatial fields.

[F6] [[def-emg-geometry-units]]: In the adopted length-coordinate SI
convention, $x^0=ct$, $g$ is dimensionless, curvature has units m$^{-2}$,
$K$ has units m$^{-1}$, $F$ has units tesla and $j$ has units A m$^{-2}$.

[L1] [[lem-emg-fieldstrength-positive-symmetric-reduction]]: The current authored Statement gives the six-field Maxwell principal block
$P(\zeta)=\zeta(n)I_6+S(\zeta_\perp)$ and positive time matrix
$\alpha^{-1}I_6$; its local proof supplies this exact mathematical interface.

[L2] [[lem-emg-maxwell-stress-conservation]]: The current authored Statement gives $\nabla^aT_{\mathrm{EM},ab}=-F_{bc}j^c$ under the adopted sourced Maxwell
sign; its local proof supplies this exact mathematical interface.

records.disposition: ODE-used-interface-compatible-at-CP-owner-released-final-bytes; ready-for-root-record within retained ODE responsibility only
clauses:
Choose $w\in(0,1)$, a constant $H>0$ with units m$^{-1}$, and $N_*>0$ with
units m$^{-3}$. Use the Einstein coupling
$\kappa=\kappa_E=8\pi G_N/c^4>0$ from [[def-emg-geometry-units]], with units
m J$^{-1}$. Set
$$J=(0,\infty),\qquad \epsilon_*:=\frac{3H^2}{\kappa},\qquad p(\epsilon):=w\epsilon,\qquad \Lambda:=0.$$
Then $\epsilon_*>0$ has units J m$^{-3}$. Adopt the linear EOS on all of
$J$, use $\epsilon_*$ as the normalization point in the definition of $N$,
and set the advected charge-per-particle field to $Z\equiv0$.

On $\Sigma=\mathbb T^3_{2\pi}:=\mathbb R^3/(2\pi\mathbb Z)^3$, assign the
spatial period length $2\pi\,\mathrm m$ in the length-coordinate convention of
[[def-emg-geometry-units]], and use the standard smooth quotient structure and
orientation. Take the flat metric $h=\delta$,
prescribe $K=Hh$, set the constant energy density $\epsilon_0=\epsilon_*$,
take fluid velocity $u_0=\mathfrak n$, and set $e=b=0$. The slice is compact
and has no boundary. The equation of state is strict on the open density interval, the
current vanishes, and the Einstein and Maxwell constraints hold exactly. By
the local theorem, these data admit a smooth local development, conditional
on $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$, Dependent Choice, the adopted model and the exact mathematical hypotheses used by [[pthm-emg-local-charged-fluid-model]]. This example is a model
calculation, not an observation.

[F1] [[def-emg-strict-charged-barotropic-system]]: For $p=p(\epsilon)$,
$N(\epsilon)=N_*\exp(\int_{\epsilon_*}^{\epsilon}dz/(z+p(z)))$,
$j=cNZu$, and
$T_{m,ab}=(\epsilon+p)u_au_b+pg_{ab}$.

[F2] [[lem-emg-charged-fluid-positive-symmetric-reduction]]: The model's
enthalpy coordinate is
$r(\epsilon)=\int_{\epsilon_*}^{\epsilon}\sqrt{p'(z)}/(z+p(z))\,dz$,
with derivative $r'=\sqrt{p'}/(\epsilon+p)>0$ when $0<p'<1$.

[F5] [[pthm-emg-local-charged-fluid-model]]: Under the displayed smooth data,
Einstein and Maxwell constraints, $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ and Dependent Choice,
the adopted equations admit a smooth local development. Its current authored proof uses the exact local Maxwell block [L1] and stress identity [L2] at their stated hypotheses.

[F6] [[thm-gr-constraint-equations-in-normal-frame]]: With
$K(X,Y)=g(\nabla_X\mathfrak n,Y)$, the Hamiltonian constraint is
$R(h)+\tau^2-|K|_h^2=2\Lambda+2\kappa T(\mathfrak n,\mathfrak n)$ and the
momentum constraint is $(\operatorname{div}_hK)(X)-D_X\tau=\kappa
T(\mathfrak n,X)$.

[F7] [[post-emg-strict-charged-fluid-model]]: In the adopted strict-interior
model the barotropic characteristic speed is $c_{\mathrm s}:=c\sqrt{p'(\epsilon)}$
for $0<p'(\epsilon)<1$.

[F8] [[def-emg-geometry-units]]: In length coordinates all coordinate values
are measured in metres with $x^0=ct$; the speed constant $c$ has units m
s$^{-1}$ and $\kappa_E=8\pi G_N/c^4$ has units m J$^{-1}$.

[L1] [[lem-emg-fieldstrength-positive-symmetric-reduction]]: Its current
authored Statement and local proof give the Maxwell field-strength symmetric principal block at its stated admissible metric conditions.

[L2] [[lem-emg-maxwell-stress-conservation]]: Its current authored Statement and local proof give $\nabla^aT_{\mathrm{EM},ab}=-F_{bc}j^c$ for the adopted source sign, with Maxwell closure and divergence equations as hypotheses.
